name: Deactivate a Platform Game Type
description: Toggle a Platform's Game Type availability through an internal action.

queries.name: platforms
queries.sql: SELECT id, active FROM platforms WHERE id = ? ORDER BY id

queries.name: platform_game_type_map
queries.sql: SELECT platform_id, game_type_id, active, cost_percent FROM platform_game_type_map WHERE platform_id = ? ORDER BY platform_id, game_type_id

queries.name: activity_log
queries.sql: SELECT id, log_name, subject_type, subject_id, description FROM activity_log WHERE log_name = 'platform' AND subject_id = ? ORDER BY id
